caption: A person skillfully tosses several coins in the air, catching them one by one.
first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A person skillfully tosses several coins in the air, catching them one by one. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The person must hold at least one coin in their hand before initiating the toss.
Coins must be tossed into the air in a controlled manner to allow for sequential catching.
The person must catch each tossed coin before it lands on the surface or other objects.
The hand position and grip must adjust to securely catch each coin as it returns.
